auth_description: Log in with your myQ account email and password. Basic garage-door control does not require a paid subscription; the CLI uses the legacy MyQ sign-in flow to mint a bearer token for the device APIs.
description: Control a myQ Smart Garage Opener from the terminal with login-based device listing and open/close commands. No subscription is required for basic access.

novel_features.name: Device roster
novel_features.description: List every account and garage device the logged-in myQ account can see, including serial number, device type, and current door state.

novel_features.name: Door state lookup
novel_features.description: Fetch the current door state for a specific device serial number.

novel_features.name: Open command
novel_features.description: Send the myQ open action and wait for the door state to become open.

novel_features.name: Close command
novel_features.description: Send the myQ close action and wait for the door state to become closed.
